title: Repo Infrastructure
description: Add repo docs, CI gates (GitHub Actions / Jenkins, dependency-cycle check), quality checks (knip, pre-push audit + secretlint) and a scheduled dependency-upgrade workflow. Existing files are kept unless --force.

with.description: Comma-separated parts: docs, ci, quality, upgrades; or all, none.

ci.description: Comma-separated CI providers: github-actions, jenkins. The upgrade workflow is GitHub Actions only.

ciCache.description: GitHub Actions: cache the Nx cache directory (actions/cache).

flutter.description: Set up Flutter in CI (subosito/flutter-action on GitHub, a flutter --version check on Jenkins): auto when a pubspec.yaml is under apps/ or libs/, on, or off.

upgradeSchedule.description: When the dependency-upgrade workflow runs: weekly (Monday 03:17 UTC) or monthly (1st, 03:17 UTC).

upgradeScope.description: polystack: pstack update to the latest release. nx-minor: also nx migrate within the current Nx major.

force.description: Overwrite files that already exist. .husky/pre-push is always appended to, never replaced.

lintStaged.description: lint-staged ESLint step: warn (report problems, never block the commit) or block. Unset: unchanged.

exif.description: Source-image EXIF/XMP/IPTC: fix (lint-staged strips staged images), check (lint-staged refuses them); both add the root assets:* scripts and a CI check step. off removes pstack's lint-staged and CI steps. Unset: unchanged.
